Why UK duty is 0% on most of what we make

Pakistan is one of 16 countries in the Enhanced Preferences tier of the UK’s Developing Countries Trading Scheme (DCTS), which carries 0% import duty on 92% of product lines. A supplier in China pays the full UK Global Tariff on the same garment.

What changed on 1 January 2026. Apparel in HS chapters 61 and 62 used to need two significant manufacturing processes in Pakistan — producing the fabric as well as making the garment — before it qualified. That requirement was removed. Enhanced Preferences countries now use the same product-specific rules as the top tier and may source between 47.5% and 100% of a garment’s inputs abroad, so ordinary cut-and-sew production qualifies.

Two caveats we would rather state than have you discover. It is 92% of product lines, not every line, so the rate follows your garment’s commodity code — we check yours and give you the number instead of estimating. And duty is not VAT: 20% import VAT still applies, although a VAT-registered UK business normally reclaims it as input tax. Both are verifiable against GOV.UK’s own tier list, and we would rather you checked than took our word for it.

Post-Brexit imports are simpler than most founders fear when the supplier ships DDP, and cheaper than most expect: Pakistan sits in the Enhanced Preferences tier of the UK Developing Countries Trading Scheme, which carries 0% import duty on 92% of product lines. We handle the 20% import VAT paperwork, so your quote equals your landed cost. Pakistan's working day overlaps the entire UK business day, so sampling conversations happen in real time - a genuine advantage over Far-East time zones. Fits are cut to UK/EU size standards on request.

FAQ: Manufacturing for British Brands

Do you handle UK import duty and VAT?

Yes. Pakistan is in the Enhanced Preferences tier of the UK Developing Countries Trading Scheme, so most garments enter the UK at 0% import duty rather than the UK Global Tariff a Chinese supplier pays. Import VAT at 20% still applies and is normally reclaimable if you are VAT-registered. We ship DDP and handle the paperwork, and we confirm the duty rate against your garment commodity code before quoting rather than assuming it.

How long is delivery to the UK?

Express courier takes 3-5 business days after production; total from approved sample to UK doorstep is typically 3-5 weeks.

Can you match UK sizing?

Yes - we grade to UK/EU size charts and can replicate the fit of any UK reference garment. Publish our garment measurements on your product pages to cut returns.

What is the minimum order?

50 pieces per style. UK startups typically launch with 2-3 styles at 50 pieces each - about the cost of a single style at a conventional 300-piece factory.

Are you audited for UK retail requirements?

We run a documented 4-stage QC process - the compliance set UK retailers and marketplaces ask suppliers for.
